capabilities: Send notes, markdown selections, images, videos and PDFs to a popout player-screen window
Control video playback and PDF page navigation from a controller view in the main window
Apply fog of war to images and maps, revealing and covering areas from the controller
Open searchable media pickers for images, videos and PDFs via commands
Expose a plugin API so other plugins can send content directly to the screen
extras: Fog of War code is credited to TomtheHoff; README recommends pairing with TTRPG Tools: Maps for advanced map presentation and notes that platform limitations may affect popout window positioning.
problem: Running tabletop sessions from Obsidian means the GM's screen shows private content, with no built-in way to push handouts, maps and media to a display players can see.

relations.evidence: Works with TTRPG Tools: Maps formerly known as Zoom Map
relations.plugin: TTRPG Tools: Maps (formerly known as Zoom Map)

summary: Second-screen display plugin that sends notes, markdown snippets, images, videos, PDFs and maps to a player-facing popout window controlled from the GM's vault.
